question: Which chapter concludes in the section emerging in Candra-dvīpa?
premises: A section is described as having emerged in Candra-dvīpa.
A chapter is identified by an ordinal number.
The chapter is named as the ninth.
inference: The ninth chapter concludes in the section emerging in Candra-dvīpa.
plain_english: This is the ninth chapter, in the section that emerged in Candra-dvīpa.
